ecoapp.descripcion: A web platform that promotes recycling through artificial intelligence. It identifies the correct bin from a photo, and also offers a community forum, gamification, environmental impact statistics, an AI assistant, and a map of nearby recycling centers.

ahorcado.descripcion: An interactive web application built as an academic project. It pulls words from a MySQL database, gives the player hints, and tracks game progress.

bullets: Customer service and support for the sales department.

ecoapp.descripcionCorta: AI-assisted recycling platform with a community forum and gamification.
ecoapp.descripcionLarga: A web platform that promotes recycling through artificial intelligence. It identifies the correct bin from a photo, and also offers a community forum, gamification, environmental impact statistics, an AI assistant, and a map of nearby recycling centers.

kinalgourmet.descripcionCorta: Platform connecting restaurants and customers for online food orders.
kinalgourmet.descripcionLarga: Kinal Gourmet House aims to partner with restaurants that want to publish their menus and profiles on the platform, letting customers browse a variety of restaurants and place food orders directly through the app.

kinalbank.descripcionCorta: Digital bank enabling transfers, deposits, and real-time currency conversion.
kinalbank.descripcionLarga: Kinal Bank aims to streamline and maximize security between the user and the bank. It supports transfers, deposits, and access to products and memberships. It integrates the Exchange API for real-time currency conversion — for example, sending money from a dollar account to a quetzal account with the conversion handled automatically.

lanatasks.descripcionCorta: Academic task manager with reminders, a calendar, and an AI assistant.
lanatasks.descripcionLarga: LanaTasks lets you sign up and organize tasks with ease: assign priority, subject, and due date, get reminders, and mark tasks as complete. It includes a calendar for important dates and a built-in AI assistant that answers task-related questions. Sign-in is simple: email, password, and name.

vetmed.descripcionCorta: Desktop system for vet clinics: appointments, treatments, vaccines, and billing.
vetmed.descripcionLarga: VetMed is a desktop application that streamlines veterinary clinic work through a dashboard for managing clients, pets, consultations, appointments, treatments, vaccinations, veterinarians, medications, prescriptions, invoices, purchases, suppliers, and employees, all with full CRUD operations (add, edit, delete, search).

essenzaco.descripcionCorta: Admin system for a perfume shop: customers, suppliers, sales, and purchases.
essenzaco.descripcionLarga: EssenzaCo is a platform for a perfume shop that lets the administrator manage customers, suppliers, products, employees, sales, and purchases (including line-item detail) from a dashboard with full CRUD operations. It also includes a storefront where end users can browse and buy products.
